memory.name: memory
memory.description: Show typed memory, transcript, session, and context statistics.
memory.detail: Reports public episodic, vector, graph, transcript, lifecycle, priming, app-session, and last-context metrics. Empty stores report zero; unavailable or unconfigured components are labeled honestly.

meta.name: meta
meta.description: List active meta insights with lifecycle and provenance metadata.
meta.detail: Queries typed short- and long-term meta_insight records, excludes decayed records, and shows bounded synthesis provenance, source, confidence, and verification fields when available. It never runs synthesis or reorganization.

arguments.description: Use 'nodes' for node details or provide an entity name to inspect.
